description: Emplacement des Arrêts de Bus du Réseau Transport Saint-Malo Agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SAINT-MALO AGGLOMERATION. Geographical location of the bus stops of the urban and peri-urban transport network on the territory of the agglomeration of the Pays de Saint-Malo. The projection used is RGF93/CC48. Coverage: SAINT-MALO AGGLOMERATION. The portal shows the English title as "Location of the Bus Stops of the Réseau Transport Saint-Malo Agglomeration" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SAINT-MALO AGGLOMERATION. Its keywords include bus, reseau-de-transport, arret, transport. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2016-08-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
